title: Machine learning screening nominates PIK3C2A as an angiogenesis-related molecule in pulmonary hypertension
summary: Logistic regression, random forest and LASSO identified four model genes (DCN, DKK1, PIK3C2A, UNC5B) among angiogenesis-related differentially expressed genes in GSE15197; the angiogenesis score reached an AUC of 0.949. PIK3C2A was downregulated and enriched in endothelial cells, and qRT-PCR confirmed its downregulation in MCT and SuHx rat lungs and pulmonary arteries. Datasets are small and public, and the rat qPCR confirms expression only.
ai_technology: Logistic regression, random forest and LASSO selecting model genes from transcriptomic data

evidence.tested: Cross-species dataset GSE1909 and qRT-PCR of PIK3C2A in two rat pulmonary hypertension models.
evidence.unknown: Whether PIK3C2A has a causal or diagnostic role in patients; per-gene discrimination was not independently reported.
evidence.ai_role: Three machine-learning algorithms selected the model genes, among them PIK3C2A.
